## What This Retrospective Cannot Tell You

This document proves which posts left a traceable mark on the current
codebase. It does NOT prove those posts' full lesson content is still
accurate — a post could be marked present via one surviving comment
while most of its original teaching context has since been refactored.
Treat this as a citation index, not a completeness guarantee.
